name: m07-7.9-linux
title: Lab 7.9: hijack a helpdesk agent through a ticket attachment, contain it one control at a time, detect it, kill it, prove it; then a real local model through Ollama
before: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh -o ollama-install.sh && sh ollama-install.sh && rm -f ollama-install.sh
sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now ollama || (setsid nohup ollama serve >/tmp/ollama.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &)
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version && break; sleep 2; done

steps.label: Kill
steps.type: make kill && python3 agent.py --safe --approver approve-all; make unkill

steps.label: Ollama
steps.type: ollama --version && ollama pull llama3.2:3b && ollama list

steps.label: Real model
steps.type: make clean && python3 agent.py --backend ollama --ollama-model llama3.2:3b --approver deny
